messages:
maya_cs: Drafting a short customer-facing runbook for launch priming + streaming fallbacks + renewal-risk signals. Need 1-pager that CS can hand to customers.

alex_sre: Actionable steps only. detect -> mitigate -> notify. Add circuit-breaker numbers.

sara_eng: Say what to prefill (prefixes), TTL, parallelism, jitter. Recommend staggered priming windows and cap per-tenant priming to ~15% node capacity. Mention tokenization throttling (50ms gap) when priming many tenants.

maya_cs: Draft prefill CLI for customers: redwood prefill --tenant T-321 --keys prefixes.json --parallel 4 --ttl 3600 --jitter 30s

lia_cs: Renewal signals CS will monitor: 7-day DAU drop >20%, p95 latency breaches, rising streamed response timeouts, negative support sentiment. Create a simple risk_score = weighted(usage_drop, latency_change, error_rate, feedback). Escalate if >=0.6.

alex_sre: Suggested thresholds: priming 30-90m before launch, priming concurrency <15% of node capacity, circuit-breaker if p95>1000ms for 3min OR error_rate>3% -> route to compact model. Cost guardrail: require approval if prefill spend > $200/day. Include on-call contact.

maya_cs: Rollback checklist for CS: 1) pause priming job 2) flip route to fallback model 3) clear primed keys if needed 4) open joint incident channel with eng-sre 5) offer to revert config.

ops-bot: Job scheduled: prefill-T-321 (id: pf-0912) start 2026-06-01T05:00:00Z.

maya_cs: I'll consolidate into a 1-pager + two templates (customer notice + rollback). Will publish draft tomorrow unless objections.
